_meta.description: Flavour-family buckets: each of the 71 odour descriptor words, and the 40 ingredient descriptor words Ari approved on 23 October 2026, maps to exactly one of 10 families. The engine's flavor_wheel aggregates an ingredient's compound descriptors into these families; engine.notices reads an ingredient's curated descriptors through the same map. Taste-active classes (bitter/pungent) are a separate overlay, not odour families.
_meta.status: Approved by Ari (bartender review, Phase 3 gate) — 10 families, as-is. Ingredient descriptor words added with Ari's approval on 23 October 2026 (data/descriptor_words_proposal.json).
_meta.coverage: All 71 odour descriptor words in compound_descriptors.json are assigned; no orphans. Ingredient descriptor words for taste, style, colour or texture are left out on purpose (listed in data/descriptor_words_proposal.json).

taste_overlay.description: Non-volatile tastants have no odour; they colour a wheel as a separate taste ring rather than an odour family.
